notes.title: A Big Update for the Find Love or Die Trying Series is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi, Auden here!

It's hard to believe it's been almost 3 and a half years since Find Love or Die Trying was released!

Thank you so much for all your support in helping me continue to make games. To everybody across this beautiful planet who's supported the game, thank you so much.

I'm ecstatic to announce that more news on the future of Find Love or Die Trying is coming soon!

I can't wait for you to see the next chapter of Find Love or Die Trying!


Thank you so much again.

Sincerely,
Auden Cho-Wong

notes.title: Happy 3rd Birthday to Find Love or Die Trying!
notes.content:
Hey there! Auden here.

It's hard to believe it's been 3 years since I released Find Love or Die Trying!

It's even harder for me to believe that it's been a whole 5 years since I first started working on it.

Thank you so much for your continued support, and for being a part of this wild, wild journey with me.

I'm happy to announce that the sequel DLC, Find Love or Die Trying: Til Death Do Us Part, will be coming out soon! I hope you enjoy it as much as I do.

You can see the new logo and learn more about the upcoming sequel here!

Thanks again for your time, and stay tuned for more!

- Auden Cho-Wong

notes.title: Find Love or Die Trying PC Bugfix Patch - Oct 11 2021
notes.content:
- Various spelling and grammar fixes
- Allie no longer incorrectly shows in front of other characters on her third date

Thank you to everybody in the discord for helping me catch these errors!

The same fixes & previous performance improvements will be coming soon to Mac. I'm working as hard as I can on my own to get these fixes across both Windows and Mac!

notes.title: Find Love or Die Trying Release Patch - Sept 18 2021
notes.content:
- Changing your mind on who's your favorite soulmate candidate on Day 3 no longer soft locks the game
- CPU Performance Issues due to unlocked frame rate no longer occurs, framerate is now limited by default
- Name of non-favorite soulmate candidate no longer shows as empty at times
- Various spelling and grammar fixes
